title: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head O (Ministry of Health)

sections.label: Healthcare 2020 Masterplan goals
sections.summary: MOH's 2012 Healthcare 2020 Masterplan set goals on quality, affordability and accessibility, with quantitative manpower, infrastructure and financial targets.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The Healthcare 2020 Masterplan that was enunciated by MOH in 2012 outlined clear goals in terms of healthcare quality, affordability and accessibility, and put forward concrete, quantitative objectives in terms of manpower, infrastructure and financial targets.

sections.label: Update on Healthcare 2020
sections.summary: The Member asks the Minister whether Healthcare 2020 is accomplished and what updates exist to the national healthcare vision.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: At this juncture, I would like to ask the Minister for an update of whether it is "mission accomplished" for Healthcare 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Further to this, I would like to ask the Ministry what updates have been made to our national vision for healthcare in the coming decade and beyond?

sections.label: Alexandra Hospital care delivery models
sections.summary: Alexandra Hospital, serving Queenstown residents, piloted care models where patients are looked after by functionally grouped healthcare professionals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The newly established Alexandra Hospital, which serves many of my residents from Queenstown, has piloted new care delivery models where patients are looked after by a team of healthcare professionals grouped functionally rather than by medical specialty.

sections.label: Electronic health records and telemedicine
sections.summary: The Member asks for updates on the National Electronic Health Records roll-out and notes telemedicine benefits for impaired and outbreak-affected patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Does the Minister have any updates on the roll-out of the National Electronic Health Records system?

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Next, an ageing population portends that a greater proportion of the health seeking population may have physical or cognitive impairments that makes it difficult for them to physically access health services.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Outbreaks like COVID-19 also bring into stark relief the benefits that telemedicine or remote medicine and remote consultation can bring.

sections.label: Healthcare 2020 accessibility affordability plans
sections.summary: The Masterplan aimed at accessibility, affordability and quality, including new hospitals, more subsidised drugs, CHAS and new polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: The Healthcare 2020 Masterplan aimed for improvements in accessibility, affordability and quality of healthcare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: These included plans to build new, general and community hospitals, increase the number of subsidised drugs and to make primary healthcare more affordable and accessible through the Community Healthcare Assist Scheme (CHAS) and also the building of new polyclinics.

sections.label: Diabetes lifetime risk
sections.summary: One in three Singaporeans had a lifetime risk of developing diabetes, with serious and costly consequences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One in three Singaporeans had a lifetime risk of developing diabetes, with serious and costly consequences.

sections.label: WHO vaccine development timeline
sections.summary: The World Health Organization has opined that developing a safe vaccine would take 18 months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As for containment, the World Health Organization has opined that it would take 18 months to develop a safe vaccine.

sections.label: Healthcare spending increase
sections.summary: Healthcare spending is expected to jump 16.2% this year, with $1.9 billion more for subsidies and COVID-19 measures, reaching $13.4 billion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Chairman, our healthcare spending is expected to jump 16.2% this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: The increase of $1.9 billion will go to fund higher subsidies and contingency measures for the COVID-19 outbreak.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: At $13.4 billion this year, healthcare is the second highest expenditure after defence.

sections.label: Flexi-Medisave limit utilisation
sections.summary: In 2018, about 16% of individuals fully utilised their Flexi-Medisave limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2018, about 16% of individuals fully utilised their Flexi-Medisave limits.

sections.label: MediSave flexibility and cap
sections.summary: A member asks whether MOH can consider increasing the flexibility of and annual cap on MediSave use.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: While I personally believe that children who can afford it, should support parents, I respect his fierce sense of self-reliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Therefore, can the MOH consider increasing the flexibility of and annual cap on the use of MediSave?

sections.label: Eczema, chronic diseases, elderly healthcare
sections.summary: An estimated 13% of Asians have eczema, and the Marine Parade Cluster saw an 11% average rise in seniors from 2016 to 2019, with the elderly four times more likely to be hospitalised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Statistically, an estimated 13% of Asians suffer from eczema.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Therefore, could the Ministry review the list of chronic diseases under the Chronic Disease Management Programme and consider including chronic conditions such as eczema?

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Together with the Marine Parade GRC and Mountbatten SMC, the Marine Parade Cluster has seen an average increase of 11% in our senior population from 2016 to 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Studies have shown that the elderly are four times more likely to be hospitalised than younger Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Therefore, what is MOH’s plan to expand capacity in eastern Singapore to cope with the anticipated increase and demand for healthcare?

sections.label: Elderly hospital admissions ratio
sections.summary: One-third of patients admitted to hospital in Singapore were aged 65 and above, and this ratio is set to rise yearly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: One-third of the patients admitted into hospital here in Singapore were aged 65 and above and this ratio is set to rise year on year.

sections.label: New polyclinics by 2030
sections.summary: MOH said it would build 10 to 12 new polyclinics by 2030, bringing the total to 30 to 32, with ten locations confirmed and at least three opening by 2025.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: MOH had earlier announced that it would be building 10 to 12 new polyclinics by 2030, thereby expanding the total number to be between 30 and 32.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Ten of the polyclinics' locations have been confirmed, with at least three scheduled to be opened by 2025.

sections.label: Polyclinic expansion to 30-32
sections.summary: MOH announced it would expand polyclinics from the current 20 to about 30 to 32 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Chairman, MOH announced that it would expand the number of polyclinics from the current 20 to about 30 to 32 by 2030.

sections.label: Singapore Mental Health Study findings
sections.summary: The 2016 study found one in seven Singaporeans had a lifetime mental disorder, depression was most common at 6.3%, and treatment delay fell from four years to one.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, Sir, the 2016 Singapore Mental Health Study found that one in seven Singaporeans have experienced a mental disorder in their lifetime.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Depression is the most common disorder, with around 6.3% of adults suffering from major depressive disorder at some point in their lives.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The good news is that people are now more aware and more willing to seek treatment.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Thus, the years of delay in seeking treatment for major depressive disorders have dropped from four in the 2010 study to one in the 2016 study.

sections.label: MediSave for outpatient mental health
sections.summary: Patients can withdraw up to $500 a year from MediSave for outpatient mental health treatments, while subsidised treatment estimates ranged from $220 to $380 a month.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Lastly, on affordability, patients can withdraw from MediSave up to $500 a year for outpatient mental health treatments, but estimates for subsidised treatments ranged from $220 to $380 a month.

sections.label: Mental health cost and coverage gaps
sections.summary: Over 65% of consultation respondents felt mental healthcare costs were high, and the passage asks when MediShield and MediSave parity will be rectified and why OCD and substance abuse are excluded from CDMP.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Through the public consultation, more than 65% of the respondents felt that costs for mental healthcare was high, prompting some to stop treatment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One shared, "I stopped my therapy at the hospital because I just couldn't afford it even at $17 twice a month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It caused me to be more depressed instead." There exists a significant disparity between claim and withdrawal limits under MediShield and Medisave for physical and mental health conditions, which is incongruent with the increasing prevalence of mental illness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Could the Ministry please clarify when this overdue parity in MediShield and MediSave limits for physical and mental health treatments will be rectified?

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) and substance abuse are currently excluded from the list of mental health conditions covered under the Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP) for MediSave withdrawals despite the increasing and high prevalence of these two conditions according to the Singapore Mental Health Study 2016.

sections.label: Free initial mental health consultations
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry would pilot free initial mental health consultations, noting 4.4 psychiatrists and 8.3 psychologists per 100,000 and median waits of 27 and 28 days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Lastly, to remove the first cost hurdle and encourage help-seeking behaviour, would the Ministry consider piloting programmes that provide free initial mental health consultations with a psychiatrist or psychologist?

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: We have 4.4 psychiatrists and 8.3 psychologists per 100,000 population.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Overall, the median waiting time for new subsidised appointments is 27 and 28 days to see a psychiatrist or a psychologist respectively.

sections.label: TAFEP mental health declaration ruling
sections.summary: TAFEP declared that stating mental health history on job application forms is discriminatory, welcomed as 48 respondents cited confidentiality issues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices' (TAFEP) recent declaration that stating one's mental health history on job application forms is discriminatory is very welcomed, especially as 48 respondents or 12%, from this public consultation cited confidentiality issues as a prohibitive factor against seeking help.

sections.label: Framework for mental health information
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry would consider a framework on mental health information declaration, accessibility and confidentiality processes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In light of these issues, would the Ministry consider establishing a framework on rightful instances requiring mental health information declaration, accessibility of patient's mental health information within the public healthcare system and better processes for breaking of confidentiality, for example, professionals to discuss with individuals on which information continues to be kept confidential?

sections.label: Mental healthcare access for deaf persons
sections.summary: The passage asks what measures support hard-of-hearing or deaf persons in mental healthcare, noting a 2018 IMH study on young adults.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yip Pin Xiu (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Access to mental healthcare for deaf persons is one such example.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yip Pin Xiu (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Given that mental health support is typically given through oral consultation, whether in counseling or therapy, can the Ministry share what measures are in place to ensure that those who are hard of hearing or deaf are adequately supported by our mental healthcare professionals, both in public hospitals and community settings?

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: According to a 2018 study by the Institute of Mental Health (IMH), young adults are most at risk of suffering from mental health issues in Singapore.

sections.label: Young NTUC youth workplace survey
sections.summary: A Young NTUC study of over 120 youths found close to 60% ranked mental well-being as their top workplace concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: A recent study that Young NTUC conducted with over 120 youths found that close to 60% ranked mental well-being as their top workplace concern.

sections.label: Home filled with rubbish, OCD
sections.summary: On attending at her home, he observed the entire hall filled with rubbish by the lady, who appears to have OCD.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: When he attended at her home, he observed, to his shock, that the entire hall of her home was filled with rubbish by the lady, who appears to be suffering from Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD).

sections.label: No parental consent, IMH intervention
sections.summary: Without parents' consent the IMH Crisis Team could not intervene, and the boy could not be arrested under the Mental Capacities Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Without the parents’ consent, there was no way even for the IMH Crisis Team to attend at the scene to intervene to help the boy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In addition, because the boy's actions were not deemed to be a danger to himself or others, he cannot be arrested under the Mental Capacities Act and brought to IMH, too.

sections.label: Integrated plan for patients needing help
sections.summary: It suggests engaging grassroots organisations, Police, SSOs and FSCs in an integrated way to draw up a plan for each patient identified as needing help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Not only that, they were undergoing serious stress themselves and would have suffered mental meltdown, if not for subsequent intervention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Hence, it may be useful to consider engaging the representatives of organisations involved such as the grassroots organisation, Police, SSO, FSCs and so on in an integrated way so that a plan may be drawn up for each patient who has been identified as needing help.

sections.label: TCM and Chinese medicine regulation
sections.summary: Only Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners are regulated under separate legislation, while Chinese proprietary medicines are regulated by HSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Currently, only Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners are regulated under separate legislation and Chinese proprietary medicines are regulated by HSA.

sections.label: Regulating CAM practitioners
sections.summary: Citing a 2017 Straits Times article on CAM use in chemotherapy, it proposes MOH study regulating CAM practitioners like TCM practitioners under a possible Complementary and Alternative Medicine Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: A 2017 Straits Times article reported that CAM is widely used by patients doing chemotherapy which sometimes increases the side effects of chemotherapy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: The same article also reported that the use of CAM also delayed a patient seeking western treatment by an extra six weeks as compared to non-CAM users, exacerbating their conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: With the pitfalls that patients could suffer from CAM being left unregulated, I propose that MOH considers studying the possibility of a regime that can regulate CAM practitioners in the same way TCM practitioners are being regulated now, which can fall under the ambit of a potential Complementary and Alternative Medicine Act.

sections.label: COVID-19 case numbers on 4 March
sections.summary: As of 4 March 2020, there were 112 confirmed cases, 79 discharged and 33 patients remaining in hospital.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As of 4 March 2020, yesterday, we have 112 confirmed cases, 79 have been discharged while 33 patients remain in hospital.

sections.label: PCR test development and sharing
sections.summary: Singapore's National Public Health Laboratory developed a specific PCR diagnostic test within just over a week, and A*STAR produced a PCR test kit used locally and shared with international partners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Within just over a week, Singapore’s National Public Health Laboratory (NHPL) developed a specific PCR diagnostic test.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Shortly after, A*STAR produced a PCR test kit, which has been used locally and shared with international partners to help identify patients and contain the disease.

sections.label: Special Bonus for healthcare workers
sections.summary: A Special Bonus will be given to healthcare workers in public hospitals and institutions directly involved with treating COVID-19 patients.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As Deputy Prime Minister announced, we will be giving them a token of appreciation through a Special Bonus for healthcare workers in our public hospitals and institutions, who are directly involved with treating COVID-19 patients.

sections.label: Pioneer and Merdeka Generation benefits
sections.summary: Almost one million Pioneers and Merdeka Generation seniors received over $2.5 billion in benefits, with MediShield Life rolled out and CareShield Life launching later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Since then, almost one million Pioneers and Merdeka Generation seniors have received over $2.5 billion in benefits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We rolled out the MediShield Life and will be launching CareShield Life (CSHL) later this year together with other changes to make MediSave usage more flexible which many Members of Parliament have asked about.

sections.label: Hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia rates
sections.summary: Based on National Population Health Survey 2017, about one in three residents aged 40-69 has hypertension, one in seven diabetes and two in five hyperlipidaemia.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Based on National Population Health Survey 2017, for example, approximately one in three of residents aged 40-69 has hypertension, one in seven has diabetes and two in five have hyperlipidaemia.

sections.label: Healthier meals sold growth
sections.summary: The number of healthier meals sold grew to 205 million in 2019, up from 158 million in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The number of healthier meals sold also grew to 205 million in 2019, up from 158 million in 2018.

sections.label: First phase redevelopment completion
sections.summary: The first phase of redevelopment is scheduled to be completed by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The first phase of redevelopment is scheduled to be completed by 2030.

sections.label: New integrated hospital in east
sections.summary: Planning has commenced for a new integrated acute and community hospital in the east, targeted to be ready around 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Ms Tin will be pleased to know that we have commenced the planning of a new integrated acute and community hospital in the east, targeted to be ready around 2030.

sections.label: National health expenditure increase
sections.summary: National health expenditure increased from $13 billion in 2012 to $22 billion in 2017, or about 11% per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Overall, our national health expenditure increased from $13 billion in 2012 to $22 billion in 2017, or about 11% per annum.

sections.label: Control measures implementation rate
sections.summary: Close to 80% of the recommended control measures have been implemented or mitigated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Close to 80% of the control measures recommended have been implemented or mitigated.

sections.label: SELENA+ eye screening AI
sections.summary: SELENA+ is a deep-learning AI system detecting diabetic eye disease, glaucoma and age-related macular degeneration, referring abnormal cases to human graders, with a cardiovascular risk model to follow.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: One example we are already deploying is the Singapore Eye Lesion Analyser Plus (SELENA+).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: This is a deep-learning artificial intelligence software system which can detect three major eye conditions: diabetic eye disease, glaucoma and age-related macular degeneration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: SELENA+ highlights areas with potential vision threatening eye disease and refers abnormal cases to human graders, allowing them to focus on the more complex cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Building on SELENA+'s capabilities, a predictive risk assessment model for cardiovascular disease will be developed to help doctors accurately identify high-risk patients and conduct more timely interventions to save lives and achieve better outcomes.

sections.label: Nurses leaving public healthcare
sections.summary: About 850 local nurses leave public healthcare yearly and only around 400 return, so HSEU is in talks with Homage to offer freelance care work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: About 850 local nurses leave our public healthcare sector yearly for a variety of reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: Despite best efforts to attract them to return to nursing, only around 400 return to practice annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye
sentences.text: To address this, our Healthcare Services Employees' Union (HSEU) is in partnership talks with Homage, a technology platform that matches trained and qualified care professionals to those in need of care, to explore providing nurses and care-givers who resign with opportunities to freelance as a care professional and keep their skills relevant.

sections.label: SARS cases among healthcare workers
sections.summary: About one-fifth of SARS outbreak cases occurred among healthcare workers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: The SARS outbreak saw about one-fifth of the cases occurring among healthcare workers.

sections.label: Public conversation on nursing uniform
sections.summary: A public conversation on the uniform may show whether public attitude can change, three years after Community Nursing teams were set up.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: Nevertheless, a public conversation on the uniform will be useful, if anything, to see whether the public attitude can be changed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: It has been three years since Community Nursing (CN) teams were set up as part of the Ministry's nationwide plan to bring healthcare closer to communities and homes, especially for the more vulnerable elderly residents.

sections.label: More Community Nursing Posts needed
sections.summary: With an ageing population, more Community Nursing Posts will be required, and the Minister is asked for numbers to date and planned in 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: With our rapidly ageing population, more Community Nursing Posts (CNPs) will be required in our neighbourhoods all over Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Would the Minister share an update on the number of such Community Nursing Posts to date and how many more does it intend to set up in the next 10 years?

sections.label: MOH career wage training priorities
sections.summary: The passage asks how MOH has prioritised career, wage advancement and training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: How has the MOH prioritised their career and wage advancement and training?

sections.label: AHPs and CPPs issuing MCs
sections.summary: The passage requests MOH permit AHPs and CPPs to issue MCs limited to two days per patient visit, starting with restructured institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This results in unnecessary delays to patients and is disruptive to the AHPs and CPPs as well as the doctor who might be seeing another patient.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I request that MOH consider permitting this group of healthcare professionals to issue MCs which are limited to two days per patient visit, starting with restructured healthcare institutions where AHPs and CPPs are taking on more in the management of chronic disease patients.

sections.label: Drug wastage examples and cost
sections.summary: The passage lists drug wastage examples and cites a local hospital study estimating $663 wastage per patient.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Some examples include expired drugs, drug hoarding, drugs prescribed without indication, or duplication of drug therapy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I quoted a study from a local hospital on the estimated drug wastage cost detected during hospital pharmacist visits, at any time point, to be a staggering figure of $663 per patient.

sections.label: Diabetic patients medication non-adherence
sections.summary: The passage states 2017 National Healthcare Group researchers reported seven in 20 newly diagnosed diabetic patients do not adhere to prescribed medication.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In late 2017, researchers from the National Healthcare Group Health Services and Outcomes Research department reported that seven in 20 newly diagnosed diabetic patients do not adhere to prescribed medication.

sections.label: Funding for pharmaceutical services
sections.summary: The passage proposes MOH expedite funding for pharmaceutical services including medication review, de-prescribing, delivery, adherence toolkits and multi-dose dispensaries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: These patients requiring multiple medications will most certainly be at high risk of polypharmacy and non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I would therefore like to propose to MOH to set aside and expedite funding to support pharmaceutical services, particularly in the areas of medication review and reconciliation, de-prescribing efforts and related health literacy education, medication delivery services to facilitate instalment collections to avoid medication hoarding and waste, subsidies for adherence toolkits such as pill boxes and medication packaging instructions to fill these pillboxes, and multi-dose drug sachet dispensaries to improve drug compliance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: A recent report from the MOH Health Manpower Development Plan (HMDP) visiting expert, Dr Catriona Bradley, pointed out that the resources of the current community pharmacists are not optimised, and that there is an uneven spread of work leveraging on the capabilities that exist within primary care.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: She recommends increasing the deployment of community pharmacists in the areas of medication management and pharmaceutical care, which is in line with directives from the World Health Organization's (WHO) Patient Safety Challenge of "Medication Without Harm".

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I quote verbatim, "Where multiple prescribers treat the same patients across primary and secondary care, there is a need for a central point of review for medications".

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I understand that MOH is currently piloting studies to explore the benefits and cost effectiveness of such pharmaceutical services, but in view of the ageing tsunami, expedited efforts are necessary to galvanise our healthcare professionals to oversee this urgently.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I would like the Committee to consider my proposal to increase funding towards pharmacists with regard to the above-mentioned points.

sections.label: AIC programme for frail seniors
sections.summary: The passage describes an AIC programme caring for about 500 frail seniors living alone in Chin Swee and Kreta Ayer rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: The Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) of MOH has in place such a program that presently looks after about 500 frail seniors living alone at HDB rental flats in the Chin Swee and Kreta Ayer precincts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: AIC has a team of two nurses and eight healthcare aides, who attend to the seniors; supervising their medical conditions and daily living essentials.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: This team also arranges for the grassroots volunteers and various voluntary care groups on assisting the social needs of these seniors in a coordinated effort.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: This has enabled residents to have lesser frequency of hospital visits and has enabled them to stay in their own homes despite their illnesses and immobility.

sections.label: Silver Ambassadors outreach effectiveness
sections.summary: MOH is asked how effective the Silver Ambassadors approach has been in engaging and serving seniors across the community.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: Could the MOH share how effective has this approach been in engaging and serving the needs of our seniors?

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
sentences.text: We have about 3,000 Silver Ambassadors now, how successful are we in reaching out to the different corners of our community?

sections.label: Payouts for severely disabled Singaporeans
sections.summary: A severely disabled Singaporean unable to perform three or more daily activities receives $600 for life, plus $200 monthly if Medisave is $20,000 or above.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: A severely disabled Singaporean, who is unable to perform three or more activities of daily living, will receive a payout of $600 for life, and if the Singaporean's Medisave balance is $20,000 and above, he or she can withdraw another $200 a month.

sections.label: Median income and ILTC subsidies
sections.summary: 2019 median monthly household income per member was $2,925, suggesting about half of Singaporean households get no ILTC non-residential subsidies, whose cutoff is $2,800.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: The latest figure for 2019 from the Department of Statistics for median monthly household income from work per household member is $2,925.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: This suggests that about half of Singaporean households will not get any subsidies for their elderly household member accessing ILTC non-residential services, since cut off for subsidies is $2,800.

sections.label: Assisted Living Public Housing launch
sections.summary: Singapore's first Assisted Living Public Housing for seniors, with communal facilities and programmes, will be launched in Bukit Batok in May.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: The development would even come with communal facilities and programmes to encourage social interaction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: It is an exciting development and I am glad to note that Singapore's first Assisted Living Public Housing for seniors will be launched in Bukit Batok in May.

sections.label: Life expectancy and healthy years
sections.summary: Minister Gan shared that Singaporeans have a life expectancy of 84.8 years, of which 74.2 years are lived in full health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Minister Gan shared that Singaporeans have a life expectancy of 84.8 years, of which 74.2 years are lived in full health.

sections.label: Active Ageing module in MOL app
sections.summary: The Active Ageing module in the Moments of Life app lets users browse information and sign up for HPB active ageing programmes from next month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Together with Smart Nation and Digital Government Office and Public Service Division, we have developed the Active Ageing module in the Moments of Life (MOL) app.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: From next month, not only can I browse information on the MOL app, I can also sign up and "chope" a spot for active ageing programmes by the Health Promotion Board (HPB), such as health talks, cooking demonstrations and more!

sections.label: Hip fractures rising with ageing
sections.summary: Hip fracture cases nearly doubled from 1,500 in 2000 to nearly 3,000 in 2017 with an ageing population.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With an ageing population, the number of hip fractures has nearly doubled, from 1,500 cases in year 2000 to nearly 3,000 in 2017.

sections.label: Expanded home, day and nursing care
sections.summary: Since 2015 MOH expanded home and day care places by 70% and nursing home bed capacity by 30%, giving sufficient nationwide capacity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Since 2015, MOH has expanded the number of home and day care places by 70% to support seniors to age-in-place.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: For nursing homes, we have expanded bed capacity by 30%, we now have sufficient capacity nationwide.

sections.label: Doubling eldercare centres nationwide
sections.summary: Over the next four years, at least double the eldercare centres will be funded to provide baseline support services for all seniors nationwide.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In the next four years, we will progressively level up and fund at least double the number of eldercare centres to provide an expanded suite of baseline support services for all seniors nationwide and not just those living in rental blocks.

sections.label: Extending pharmaceutical care service
sections.summary: Positive pilot feedback means the pharmaceutical care service will extend to another 2,500 seniors at more eldercare centres over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Feedback from participants of the pilot has been positive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Hence, over the next three years, we will be extending the pharmaceutical care service to another 2,500 seniors at more eldercare centres.

sections.label: Assisted living flats with service package
sections.summary: Assisted living flats will be sold twinned with a service package, giving residents 24/7 emergency response and an on-site community manager.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Unlike 2-room flexi-flats, these assisted living flats will be sold, twinned with a service package.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Elderly residents will benefit from 24/7 emergency response, as well as the assistance of an on-site community manager.

sections.label: Bukit Batok assisted living age criteria
sections.summary: The first Assisted Living flats in Bukit Batok will be reserved for seniors aged 65 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The first Assisted Living flats in Bukit Batok will be reserved for seniors aged 65 and above.

sections.label: Community outreach and frontline training
sections.summary: 43 community outreach teams were set up and over 24,000 frontline staff trained to identify and refer persons with mental health needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To that end, we have set up 43 community outreach teams and trained over 24,000 frontline staff from Government agencies and community partners across Singapore to identify persons with mental health needs in the community and refer them for appropriate support.

sections.label: MediSave limits for psychiatric stays
sections.summary: Fewer than one in 10 subsidised patients exceeded the yearly MediSave limit for inpatient psychiatric stays, and fewer than three in 10 bills exceeded the daily limit.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Based on the latest available data, fewer than one in 10 subsidised patients exceeded the MediSave yearly withdrawal limit for inpatient psychiatric stays, while fewer than three in 10 subsidised bills exceeded the MediSave daily withdrawal limit.

sections.label: Raising MediSave limit for complex conditions
sections.summary: MediSave withdrawal limits will be raised for patients with complex chronic conditions such as OCD and osteoporosis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To further defray the costs for patients with complex chronic conditions, say, a patient with OCD and osteoporosis, we will be raising their MediSave withdrawal limit.

sections.label: Support for mental health care-givers
sections.summary: A structured system of support will be piloted for care-givers of persons with mental health conditions, who are at risk of burnout.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We must also not forget that the well-being of persons with mental health conditions often rests on the care-givers, and they are at risk of burnout.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Hence, we will be piloting a structured system of support for care-givers of persons with mental health conditions.

sections.label: Additional healthcare sector jobs
sections.summary: With expanded services, up to around 6,000 additional healthcare sector jobs could arise in the next two years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With the expansion of services, we could see up to around 6,000 additional jobs in the healthcare sector in the next two years.

sections.label: Mid-career PMETs entering healthcare
sections.summary: About 2,000 local mid-career PMETs transited into healthcare in the last two years, about one-third aged 40 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the last two years, about 2,000 local mid-career PMETs transited into the healthcare sector, and about one-third of them are mature workers aged 40 and above.

sections.label: Community care salary support funding
sections.summary: MOH will set aside another $150 million over three years to support community care institutions in improving salary competitiveness, benefiting up to 4,000 local nurses and support care staff.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the next three years, MOH will set aside another $150 million to support community care institutions to further improve the competitiveness of salaries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We project that this will benefit up to 4,000 local nurses and support care staff, if it is fully taken up.

sections.label: Nurses and pharmacists prescribing training
sections.summary: Since 2019, 34 advanced practice nurses and 31 clinical pharmacists in 11 healthcare institutions have been trained and empowered to prescribe drugs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since 2019, 34 advanced practice nurses and 31 clinical pharmacists in 11 healthcare institutions have been trained and empowered to prescribe drugs to their patients.

sections.label: Monitoring before licensing under HCSA
sections.summary: MOH will monitor prevalence of use and risks to patient safety before considering whether to license these services under HCSA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: MOH will monitor the prevalence of use and risks to patient safety, before considering whether to license these services under HCSA.

sections.label: Raising healthcare retirement and re-employment ages
sections.summary: MOH raised the retirement age to 63 and re-employment age to 68 from July 2021, one year ahead of the national schedule.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2019, around 99% of public healthcare workers aged 62 and beyond were offered re-employment and 95% of them accepted the offer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To support our mature healthcare workers who are able and willing to continue working, MOH has worked with the Healthcare Services Employees' Union and public healthcare institutions to raise the retirement age to 63, and re-employment age to 68 from July 2021 onwards – one year ahead of the national schedule.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Those who wish to retire or stop working at 62 may still do so whilst those who want to keep working now have the choice to work even longer.

sections.label: Antimicrobial resistance data and action plan
sections.summary: A study noted rising community carriage of ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae, and the speaker asks for data on community antibiotic usage and an update on the National Strategic Action Plan on AMR.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: A local study reporting a 10-year review of AMR in Singapore noted a marked difference in the community rectal carriage of ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae, that is, 6.3% in 2006 versus 26% in 2016 between two dissimilar surveys, appearing to signify an increasing trend despite the differences in methodology.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: It is therefore with all urgency that I ask if MOH has any data to share on antibiotic usage in the community?

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: I understand that the antimicrobial stewardship programme has been well established in our public institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
sentences.text: I would also like to request for an update on the progress of the National Strategic Action Plan on AMR.

sections.label: Subsidised colonoscopy screening request
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the Minister will consider subsidised colonoscopy screening, which is more accurate and preventive by removing polyps early, compared to occult blood testing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lily Neo
sentences.text: Will Minister consider subsidised colonoscopy screening, as it is more accurate and is also preventive in nature by removing polyps early, compared to present occult blood testing?

sections.label: Flu vaccine take-up rates
sections.summary: Flu vaccine take-up among seniors may be around 24%, versus 70% in the UK, US and Australia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For example, for flu vaccines among seniors, our take-up rate may be around 24% versus 70% in the UK, US and Australia.

sections.label: Adult vaccine subsidy and measles
sections.summary: The speaker repeats a call for adult vaccine subsidies to consider downstream fiscal savings, noting 152 measles cases in 2019, the highest since 1997.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I would repeat my call made in Parliament for the level of subsidy given for adult vaccines to take into consideration the downstream fiscal cost savings to the state from fewer diseases as a result of vaccines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: But in 2019 there were 152 measles cases, which was the highest number of cases since 1997.

sections.label: Chile unhealthy drink labels
sections.summary: In Chile, sales of drinks with unhealthy labels fell by 25% after one-and-a-half years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: In Chile, the sales of drinks with the unhealthy labels fell by 25% after one-and-a-half years.

sections.label: Graphic labels on sugary drinks
sections.summary: A 2018 Harvard study suggested graphic warning labels on sugary drinks reduced purchases more than text-based labels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: A study by researchers at Harvard in 2018 suggested that graphic warning labels on sugary drinks reduced purchases more than text-based labels.

sections.label: Polyclinic expansion to 2030
sections.summary: The speaker announced in 2018 that polyclinics will be expanded to 30-32 by 2030, from 20 today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, may I display some slides, please.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I announced in 2018 that our network of polyclinics will be expanded to 30-32 polyclinics by 2030, from 20 today.

sections.label: Bishan and Bidadari polyclinics
sections.summary: With Bishan and Bidadari polyclinics, the target of 32 polyclinics by 2030 will be achieved.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With Bishan and Bidadari polyclinics, we will achieve our target of having 32 polyclinics by 2030.

sections.label: PCN GP clinic partners
sections.summary: More than 500 PCN GP clinic partners care for over 100,000 chronic-condition patients, up from about 70,000 last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: More than 500 PCN GP clinic partners are caring for over 100,000 patients with chronic conditions, up from about 70,000 last year.

sections.label: Breast cancer screening and diagnosis
sections.summary: Breast cancer screening rate is about 39%, and late-stage diagnosis stayed around 28% between 2008 and 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The screening rate for breast cancer is about 39% and the rate of late-stage breast cancer diagnosis has remained around 28% between 2008 and 2017.

sections.label: HPV-DNA testing for cervical cancer
sections.summary: HPV-DNA testing for women aged 30 to 69 was introduced in mid-2019 after STRC's recommendation, citing higher sensitivity and lower frequency than Pap smear.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: On cervical cancer, HPV-DNA testing for women aged 30 to 69 was introduced in mid-2019, following STRC's recommendation due to its higher sensitivity and lower frequency required, compared to the Pap smear.

sections.label: Integrated Youth Service in Woodlands
sections.summary: An Integrated Youth Service with IMH, AIC and Care Corner will start in Woodlands this year for at-risk youths.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Complementing MOE's efforts, we announced last year that we will work with the Institute of Mental Health (IMH), the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) and our community partner, Care Corner, to develop an Integrated Youth Service (IYS), where youths at risk can access coordinated mental health and social support services in the community.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am glad to update that the Integrated Youth Service will be starting in Woodlands this year.

sections.label: Surgical fees on MOH website
sections.summary: Anyone can refer to surgical fees on the MOH website; since publication, fees have generally converged, with over 80% below the upper limit.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Anyone, including doctors, patients and payers, can refer to them on the MOH website.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: I am glad to share that since its publication, surgical fees have generally converged, with the majority falling within range and more than 80% below the upper limit.

sections.label: Clusters saving on drug costs
sections.summary: The proportion has increased to 95%, resulting in clusters saving at least 5% in drug costs, benefiting patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Today, this proportion has increased to 95%, resulting in clusters saving at least 5% in drug costs, benefiting our patients in turn.

sections.label: ACE savings target
sections.summary: ACE is on track to deliver $75 million in savings over five years and will work on benefiting more Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: ACE is on track to deliver savings of $75 million over five years, and will work on benefiting even more Singaporeans.

sections.label: ACE Clinical Update Service launch
sections.summary: ACE will launch a national educational visiting service called ACE Clinical Update Service in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To support them further, ACE will be launching a national educational visiting service known as ACE Clinical Update Service (ACE CUES) in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Precision medicine strategy launch
sections.summary: The official launch of the precision medicine strategy and research programme is planned for the third or fourth quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The official launch of the precision medicine strategy and research programme is currently planned for the third or fourth quarter of this year, and more details will be made available later.

sections.label: Antimicrobial resistance joint report
sections.summary: The First Joint Report of Antimicrobial Utilisation and Resistance in Singapore will be published this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As a first step, the First Joint Report of Antimicrobial Utilisation and Resistance in Singapore will be published this year.

sections.label: Diabetes prevalence in Singapore
sections.summary: One in nine Singaporean adults had diabetes in 2010, and ageing and rising obesity will increase prevalence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: One in nine Singaporean adults were affected by diabetes in 2010.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: As our population ages, the prevalence of this disease will increase as the risk increases with age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Rising obesity also contributes to the prevalence of diabetes in our population.

sections.label: Sugar-sweetened beverage control update
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry will share an update on measures to control sugar-sweetened beverage consumption.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry share an update on the measures to control sugar-sweetened beverage consumption?

sections.label: MediSave withdrawal limits raised
sections.summary: In June 2018, MediSave withdrawal limits for CDMP conditions were raised from $400 to $500.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In June 2018, we raised MediSave withdrawal limits for conditions under the Chronic Disease Management Programme or CDMP, from $400 to $500.

sections.label: CHAS cards and subsidies
sections.summary: 1.7 million Singaporeans have CHAS cards, and in 2019 over $160 million in CHAS subsidies was disbursed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Altogether, 1.7 million Singaporeans have received their CHAS cards, seven times more than when CHAS was first launched in 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In 2019, we disbursed more than $160 million in CHAS subsidies, significantly alleviating the cost of outpatient treatments for Singaporeans.

sections.label: MediSave700 patient beneficiaries
sections.summary: More than 176,000 patients are expected to benefit from the enhanced MediSave700 scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Overall, we expect more than 176,000 patients to benefit from the enhanced MediSave700 scheme.

sections.label: Balancing medical expenses and future needs
sections.summary: The enhancements balance current medical expenses and future healthcare needs, with continued review of MediSave withdrawal limits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Overall, these enhancements are designed to strike a balance, as we have to continue to do, between current medical expenses and of course, future healthcare needs down the road.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will continue to take on board the suggestions, review our MediSave withdrawal limits in light of our overall financing framework, to introduce greater flexibility where possible, and to ensure that they are adequate for the majority of patients in subsidised settings.

sections.label: Schemes launching later this year
sections.summary: Both schemes will be launched later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Both schemes will be launched later this year.

sections.label: ElderFund safety net
sections.summary: ElderFund is a safety net for lower income and severely disabled Singaporeans, opened for applications on 31 January.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The third pillar is ElderFund, a safety net for lower income and severely disabled Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: It supports those who are unable to benefit from schemes like ElderShield with monthly cash payouts, and opened for applications on 31 January.

sections.label: Care-givers' Training Grant and respite care
sections.summary: Care-givers can use an annual $200 Care-givers' Training Grant for training, and respite care is available at over 20 eldercare centres and 40 nursing homes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Care-givers can tap on an annual $200 subsidy under the Care-givers' Training Grant to offset the costs of training for their FDWs or other approved courses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Mr de Souza will be pleased to hear that we have respite care options at more than 20 eldercare centres and 40 nursing homes, where more than 3,700 so far have benefited.

sections.label: Home Care-giving Grant
sections.summary: Launched in October 2019, the Home Care-giving Grant replaced the Foreign Domestic Worker Grant with $200 monthly cash support, with over 4,900 applications approved.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Beyond expenses for home and community-based services, care-giving expenses can take many forms and we recognise that.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, in October 2019, we launched the Home Care-giving Grant, which replaced the previous Foreign Domestic Worker Grant with an enhanced quantum of $200 per month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: By providing cash support directly to care recipients with permanent disability, care-givers have greater flexibility as to how best to deploy these resources.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have since approved more than 4,900 applications for the Home Care-giving Grant, bringing the number of beneficiaries under the scheme to over 16,000.

sections.label: New pre-packaged beverage measures
sections.summary: Two new regulatory measures for pre-packaged beverages will be implemented: a nutrient-summary label and an advertising prohibition for high sugar and saturated fat beverages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As a start, we will implement two new regulatory measures for pre-packaged beverages: a nutrient-summary label and an advertising prohibition for beverages with high sugar and saturated fat content.

sections.label: Beverage nutrient-summary label grades
sections.summary: The label grades beverages A to D by sugar and saturated fat thresholds, and shows sugar as a percentage of total volume.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On the screen, Members see an example of the label: Grade A, corresponding to the lowest sugar and saturated fat thresholds, is in dark green; while Grade D, corresponding to the highest sugar and saturated fat thresholds, is in red.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Besides the grade, we will indicate the sugar level of the beverage as a percentage of the total volume.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, if you see 12% on the label, it represents 12% sugar of the total volume in that particular product.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This provides Singaporeans with more information so that they can compare sugar levels across beverages within the same grade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Pre-packaged beverages will be graded on a single set of nutrient thresholds, based on their sugar and saturated fat content.

sections.label: Advertising prohibition for Grade D beverages
sections.summary: Advertising for Grade D beverages will be prohibited on all media platforms, including traditional and new media, across all time belts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In addition to labelling requirements, we will prohibit advertising for Grade D beverages on all media platforms, including traditional and new media platforms across all time belts.

sections.label: Extending measures to freshly prepared beverages
sections.summary: After reviewing the local landscape, the labelling and advertising measures will be extended to freshly prepared beverages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: After a careful review of the local landscape, we have decided to extend the labelling and advertising measures to freshly prepared beverages.

sections.label: Water dispensers in hawker centres
sections.summary: By mid-2020, more water dispensers will be installed in the remaining 82 hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: By mid-2020, more water dispensers will be installed in the remaining 82 hawker centres.

sections.label: Healthcare affordability and caregiving support
sections.summary: The Government will continue to enhance healthcare affordability and expand caregiving support, with policies like the enhanced MediSave700 scheme and efforts toward healthier living.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, to conclude, the Government will continue to enhance the affordability of healthcare and expand support for care-giving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Policies such as the enhanced MediSave700 scheme will provide additional peace of mind for those with chronic illnesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: At the same time, we will pursue downstream savings for our system by encouraging healthier living and supporting Singaporeans in making healthier and we believe, therefore, wiser choices in what they consume.

sections.label: Subsidies for childhood vaccinations and screening
sections.summary: Full subsidies will be provided for nationally recommended childhood vaccinations and developmental screening.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: (a)	First, full subsidies for nationally recommended childhood vaccinations and developmental screening.

sections.label: Effective dates for vaccination subsidies
sections.summary: The effective dates for the vaccination subsidies and child developmental screenings will be before the end of 2020, with exact dates announced later.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: The effective dates for the vaccinations subsidies and child developmental screenings will be before the end of 2020 – exact dates will be announced later.

sections.label: Polyclinic subsidy for lower to middle income
sections.summary: At polyclinics, eligible lower to middle income Singaporeans will get a 75% subsidy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: At polyclinics, eligible lower to middle income Singaporeans will get 75% subsidy.

sections.label: Vaccination coverage and smoking cessation
sections.summary: Amid anti-vaccination misinformation, the aim is over 50% adult vaccination coverage by 2025, and new smoking cessation models will be piloted in public healthcare institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Public education has taken on renewed importance with misinformation from the anti-vaccination camps.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: We aim to increase vaccination coverage among adult Singaporeans to over 50% by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: New smoking cessation models will be piloted in our public healthcare institutions such as hospitals, polyclinics and our national specialty centres.

sections.label: Smoking cessation success rates
sections.summary: Smoking cessation success rates in Singapore ranged from 10% for telephone-based interventions to 20% for intensive counselling with pharmaco-therapy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Success rates for smoking cessation programmes in Singapore have ranged from 10% for telephone-based interventions to 20% for programmes that combine intensive counselling and pharmaco-therapy.

sections.label: Singapore smoking rate 2019
sections.summary: The smoking rate in Singapore dropped to 10.6% in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Smoking rate in Singapore dropped to 10.6% in 2019.

sections.label: Tote Board Community Healthcare Fund
sections.summary: The Tote Board Community Healthcare Fund has committed approximately $230 million since FY2009.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: The Tote Board Community Healthcare Fund has committed approximately $230 million since FY2009.

sections.label: Integrated Volunteer Network outreach
sections.summary: Since April 2019, Integrated Volunteer Network volunteers reached over 4,000 patients and residents in rehabilitation, health screening and quit-smoking programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Since April 2019, volunteers in the Integrated Volunteer Network reached out to over 4,000 patients and residents in areas such as rehabilitation, health screening and quit-smoking programmes.

sections.label: Screening rates rise
sections.summary: Screening rates rose from 45.1% in 2010 to 66.3% in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: Screening rates have gone up from 45.1% in 2010 to 66.3% in 2019.

sections.label: Free NCIS vaccinations for children
sections.summary: All vaccinations recommended under the National Childhood Immunisation Schedule, including pneumococcal and HPV vaccines, will be free for all Singaporean children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: In other words, all vaccinations recommended under the National Childhood Immunisation Schedule (NCIS), including pneumococcal and HPV vaccines, will be provided for free to all Singaporean children.

sections.label: Polyclinic subsidy for Singaporeans
sections.summary: Lower to middle income Singaporeans will get a 75% subsidy at polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: At polyclinics, lower to middle income Singaporeans will get a 75% subsidy.

sections.label: Health is wealth reminder
sections.summary: The speaker says health is wealth and COVID-19 reminds us life is fragile and things change quickly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: (In English): Mr Chairman, truly, health is wealth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin)
sentences.text: We are reminded of how quickly things can change and how fragile life is with COVID-19.

sections.label: Polyclinic development and redevelopment
sections.summary: Up to 32 polyclinics are announced by 2030, with Ang Mo Kio redeveloped and Toa Payoh to be redeveloped.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With regard to polyclinics' development, in addition to those that we have announced for new developments, which is up to 32 polyclinics by 2030, we do have existing polyclinics that are being redeveloped, one of it was Ang Mo Kio Polyclinic which was redeveloped some time back.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And moving forward, we are also going to redevelop Toa Payoh Polyclinic.

sections.label: 70% in C and D
sections.summary: About 70% will fall into C and D, and of that about 25 to 26% will be D.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The Member's second point about the 70%, the figures approximately are 70% will fall into C and D.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And of that, about 25, 26% will be D.

sections.label: Risk of case exportation
sections.summary: Many countries have significant community spread, so there is high risk of exporting cases to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In quite a number of countries, there are already significant community spread within the country and, therefore, there is a high risk of exportation of these cases to Singapore.

sections.label: Higher cases and community spread risk
sections.summary: Returning Singaporeans may develop symptoms, so more cases are expected and community spread risk will increase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: And there may also be Singaporeans returning from these areas – they may also develop symptoms, after arrival in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Therefore, we do expect to see a significantly higher number of cases in time to come.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: With a higher number of cases in Singapore, the risk of community spread will also increase.

sections.label: Antimicrobial utilisation and resistance report
sections.summary: The first joint report on antimicrobial utilisation and resistance in Singapore will be published later this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, the first joint report of antimicrobial utilisation and resistance in Singapore will be published later this year.

sections.label: Scholars obtained between 2017 and 2019
sections.summary: Between 2017 and 2019, 17 of these scholars were obtained.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Between 2017 and 2019, we have got 17 of these scholars.

sections.label: Housing options for seniors
sections.summary: Seniors can sell and use the Proximity Housing Grant of up to $30,000, and assisted living is another housing option.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Or they can sell and use the housing grant of up to $30,000, the Proximity Housing Grant, to stay near their children or stay with their children.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we have done is work with MND, and also based on feedback to look at another housing option for seniors – assisted living, which is not just the hardware, the physical space, but is actually the flat twinned with a basic service package that will be sold to the seniors.

sections.label: OCD in CDMP
sections.summary: The Senior Minister of State confirmed OCD is included in CDMP, but the MOH website still does not show it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
sentences.text: The Senior Minister of State also confirmed that Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) is now included in Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP), but I just checked the MOH website and it is still not there.

sections.label: MediSave limit for psychiatric treatment
sections.summary: The MediSave daily withdrawal limit for psychiatric treatment is $150, compared with a 2018 average daily bill of $90 at IMH.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To give you an example, in 2018, the average daily bill size for inpatient psychiatric treatment at IMH is $90.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, if you talk about parity, we are talking about parity in terms of making sure that the withdrawal limits will cover a majority of the cost of the treatment for subsidised patients.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Therefore, for MediSave daily withdrawal limit, it is $150 for psychiatric treatment.

sections.label: GPs trained in mental healthcare
sections.summary: About 210 GPs are now trained to provide mental healthcare, as access to treatment has been increased.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the Member's information, as I have said over the years, we have tried to increase access to treatment and we have now got about 210 GPs who are trained to provide mental healthcare.

sections.label: Gender Care Clinic set up
sections.summary: The Institute of Mental Health set up the Gender Care Clinic in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition to that, let me say that in 2017, the Institute of Mental Health set up the Gender Care Clinic.

sections.label: Basic Care Assistants for nurses
sections.summary: Basic Care Assistants help take workload from nurses so nurses can focus on clinical work, with over 100 now and more than half above 50.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Lastly, even within the healthcare institutions, we have got jobs that help to take some of the workload, say, from the nurses so that nurses can focus more on their clinical work, so "Basic Care Assistants", for instance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And we have got 100-odd of them now and more than half are actually above 50.

sections.label: Community Silver Trust matching fund
sections.summary: MOH set up the Community Silver Trust in 2012 for the matching fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On the matching fund, MOH has set up the Community Silver Trust in 2012.

sections.label: Community Silver Trust funding amounts
sections.summary: The Trust began with a $1 billion Government injection and was topped up by $300 million in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Member is right that one of the things is, under our Women Health Advisory Committee, we are also looking at how we can reach out to get more to understand that if they do not do this, fracture is really a very debilitating condition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I would also like to let Ms Tin know that the Trust is made up initially of a $1 billion injection by the Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And Ms Tin might remember that in 2018, it was topped up by another $300 million.
